scope: Authored synthetic source-grounded engineering-memory diagnostic. No real-user, LLM coding-success, external-product, million-page, or universal superiority claim.

freeze.required: The new protocol, wrapper generator, runner, tests and unchanged v013_workload dependency must be committed before formal workload queries. Bind that explicit commit; preserve all failures and development diagnostics separately.
freeze.binding: run requires an explicit protocol commit and two exact, clean runtime checkouts; file bytes are checked against the protocol commit. Both runtime commits, tracked runtime file hashes, loaded backend and native extension hash are recorded.
freeze.integrity_tests_before_freeze: Pure generation, adversarial saved-response scoring, schedule and resource-bound tests are permitted before freeze. A separately labeled development profile may check 192-page plumbing after commit and must never enter formal counts.
freeze.failures: Never rewrite queries, gold, sources, timing order or budgets to remove observed failures. Corrections require a new protocol version and retain original attempts. Interrupted work is resumable with immutable attempt directories.
freeze.integrity_test_reporting: Label tests/test_v014_scale.py as evaluator integrity. It does not execute the formal retrieval matrix.

source.construction: Only MemoryBook.ingest creates original conversations, turns, sections, pages and FTS indexes. No synthetic direct table population.
source.boundary: Turn segmentation deliberately gives one real stored page per turn. It is not a study of default adaptive segmentation, long-page quality, embedding retrieval, concurrent load or operating-system cold boot.
source.similarity: Exact task names and code identifiers recur across projects; project IDs and approved numeric values differ. Original/current contracts, historical failures, Chinese queries, multi-source boundaries and source replacement are explicit. Approved current sources also contain Chinese text; Chinese cases require the original Chinese clause and code-point source coordinates. The v014 background nonce seed differs; all prior 72 source-grounded questions are retained and 16 new questions require explicitly absent exact identifiers, including eight partially answerable multi-facet requests.
source.gold_separation: Retrieval receives only query, exact project ID and fixed request options. Expected quotes/source identities are passed only to the scorer after retrieval. Directory traversal follows returned IDs without gold-guided selection.

axes.age: Fresh independent 1024-page databases, identical content and physical order, shift all source timestamps by either 3650 or 7300 days. This is a source-age control, not actual process uptime.
axes.foreign: Hold every target at its original 16 pages while foreign history grows: total 1024, 10016, 50016, 100000 pages. Project-local answers and evidence remain unchanged.
axes.own: Hold 99872 foreign pages fixed and add 100000 pages to the six active targets, reaching 200000 total. Two old targets stay at 16 pages. Own-history queries are a separate scaling axis; a small-project optimization is not evidence of bounded large-project work.
axes.layout: Rebuild exactly the 200000-page logical corpus in interleaved order; logical-source and page-ID hashes must match clustered own-200000, physical row layout must differ.
axes.replacement: Reingest the six registered active-config sources under the same identities after interleaving; changed values and timestamps are preregistered. 200000 pages remain.

expanded.interpretation: Only executed, completed cells are results. This extension is optional and uses the same quality/performance rules.

development.interpretation: Post-commit plumbing diagnostic; never pooled with formal data and never evidence for scale or unseen quality.

limits.on_limit: Flush original journals; record actual achieved counts and the exact limit. Stop and list every unexecuted checkpoint/arm. Do not extrapolate 100k or optional 200k success.

retrieval.repeated_question_boundary: Identifier and replacement prompts intentionally test the same source in different wording. Repeats, phases, projects and cache calls are not independent real-user examples.

directory.path: search_directory -> returned section IDs -> section -> returned page IDs -> read, with exact project scope on every call. Navigation titles/summaries do not count as evidence. Directory quality is a separate channel from direct recall.

measurement.backend: explicit native or python; both arms must use the same selection, actual backend recorded, never silently fall back
measurement.quality: All 88 cases per arm/checkpoint in first block, after the first-connection query. Every timing/probe response is independently source/gold checked outside its timer. Partial-answer cases count available required evidence separately from whole-request answerability.
measurement.cold_result_cache: Delete only recall_cache outside timing before each cold sample, require cache_hit=false, then immediately execute one warm call requiring cache_hit=true. Connection helper caches, pager and OS cache are not flushed. The separately labeled first-connection call precedes quality and all other retrieval in each fresh worker.
measurement.directory_cache: The directory path has no result cache. Label its repeated measurements uncached-directory; do not call them warm recall-cache hits.
measurement.isolation: No arm processes overlap. Build a baseline source snapshot through real ingest. For each stage, restore it once into a dedicated candidate-initialization worker which executes zero retrieval calls, checks an empty result cache and verifies source-table/logical-source/page-ID equality, then save a candidate-indexed snapshot. Record this one-time migration separately. Every baseline block restores only the baseline snapshot; every candidate block restores only its candidate snapshot, each in a fresh process. Original source bytes are identical; derived indexes intentionally differ. Source hashes, restore time, SQL work probes, scoring and journaling are outside uninstrumented query timers. Keep all failed attempts; lock is inherited by children.
measurement.os_cache_boundary: Restoration and earlier calls populate filesystem/OS caches. No privileged drop_caches operation or physical-storage-cold latency claim. Record host load/CPU/RSS and SQLite main/WAL/SHM sizes. ABBA helps order effects but is not proof of a noise-free isolated machine.
measurement.clock: perf_counter_ns for external API wall time; process_time_ns for child-process CPU. resource.ru_maxrss is process lifetime high-water RSS, not per-call allocation or total system memory.
measurement.statistics: Per checkpoint/arm/query/mode report n, p50, nearest-rank p95, min/max, errors, incompleteness and paired per-round medians. Four balanced rounds x eight repeats give 32 cold/directory and 32 immediate warm calls; first-connection and work probes have n=4. No p99 claim. Never pool unlike modes, probe wall time with production latency, failed partial attempts with resumed replacements, or unlike query sizes.
measurement.source_identity: Exact baseline/candidate Git commits and hashes of all tracked src/memory_book files plus the imported extension; explicit repo-root-specific PYTHONPATH in fresh subprocesses. Timings do not measure shell/subprocess startup.
measurement.host_support: Formal timing requires a POSIX host with resource, flock and SIGALRM. Integrity tests remain importable on Windows; this protocol makes no cross-platform timing claim.
measurement.call_deadline: The 20-second per-call SIGALRM deadline is best-effort: Python may handle the signal only after a SQLite/native C call returns. The parent enforces the separate 600-second hard worker timeout. A killed in-flight call has a started event but no invented latency or response; earlier completed raw records remain.
measurement.first_connection: Before any recall or directory call, run the fixed old-project current query with use_cache=False once per fresh worker. Constructor/possible migration wall and CPU time are measured separately. First-connection n=4 per arm/checkpoint is descriptive, not a stable tail estimate. Constructor and restoration may warm the OS/SQLite cache; no physical cold-boot claim.
measurement.work_probe: After uninstrumented timing samples, clear recall result cache and rerun each selected query once per arm block with SQLite set_progress_handler(interval=100) plus trace callback. Retain callbacks*100 as a coarse VM instruction proxy and SQLite trace-callback count. These are not scanned rows, complete SQLite instructions, or instrumented wall-time performance. Callbacks can reset by statement and SQLite internals vary. All probe responses remain source-checked and saved; probe timing is reported separately.
measurement.cost_scope: Builder ingestion time/calls/CPU/RSS and baseline DB size are recorded. Each arm opening/possible migration wall+CPU/storage is separate; fingerprinting, snapshot restore and journaling are outside API timing. Because source snapshots are baseline-built this does not measure candidate bulk ingestion throughput.

evidence.raw: Append-only compact timing/hash/source-reference observations plus gzip JSONL containing every complete original API response, including all failures and partial timed-out attempts. Original responses are never replaced with rescored summaries. Validation exceptions are recorded with phase=validation after retaining the original API response; invalid framing cannot silently enter valid latency samples.
evidence.dataset: Record generated payload and logical-source hashes, actual table/page/project counts, per-target rowid span/density, created-date hashes, database/snapshot sizes and file hashes. Source reconstruction uses the frozen generator, not hidden stored answers.
correctness: required evidence spans with matching original project/session/turn citations
full-source coordinate reconstruction including Chinese text
all excerpt characters backed by original source
current-evidence first rank and stale-before-current separately
missing-evidence context-return diagnostic without calling empty output calibrated abstention
directory-read source correctness and bounded evidence budget
Explicit missing and partial facets are gold; nonempty context alone is neither a correct answer nor a false answer.
Returned-excerpt identifier coverage is separate from current declaration assessment and from complete semantic answerability. Missing coverage metadata is unassessed, not silently successful.
Coverage missing identifiers must be a subset of its requested identifiers, its status and list must agree, and an explicitly present returned literal cannot receive missing credit.
evidence.comparison: Same-checkpoint baseline/candidate comparisons use the same restored DB snapshot. Layout and age controls additionally compare normalized logical-source/evidence projections; data growth may legitimately change FTS scores/ranks. Any changed answers, failures, timeouts and unexecuted cells remain visible.
evidence.snapshots: Large source DB snapshots are working artifacts and may be pruned after all dependent checkpoints and arm records are saved; their original hashes/sizes and deterministic rebuild specification remain in the manifest. Retain final snapshot when resources permit. No benchmark result is claimed solely from generated input size.
evidence.work: Record candidate_count when exposed, SQL progress callbacks and SQLite trace-callback count in separately instrumented probes. Report these exact observable quantities; do not rename them scanned rows.

supersedes.reason: Pre-formal independent review found that verifier exceptions could lose the just-returned response and inconsistent coverage metadata could receive missing-signal credit. V2 retains validation-failure responses and verifies metadata consistency; sources, gold, query schedule and budgets are unchanged.
supersedes.prior_execution: Only the explicitly labeled 192-page baseline-vs-itself development plumbing was executed; its original v1 records are preserved under benchmarks/reports/v0.14-development/plumbing-baseline-selfcheck.
